about:
# Freedoom Arcade

![Freedoom Arcade](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/petllama/FreedoomArcade/main/curseforge/logo.png)

A World of Warcraft addon that plays Freedoom, a free Doom-engine game, in a window inside the game.

The engine is a port of id Software's linuxdoom-1.10 to plain Lua 5.1. It uses floats instead of fixed point, and a renderer that draws with ordinary WoW textures:

- **Walls and sky** are one texture strip per screen column.
- **Floors and ceilings** are one strip per horizontal span, with texture coordinates interpolated along the span.
- **Sprites and masked mid-textures** are quads clipped into column runs, each on its own frame level so they sort back to front.

It ships with [Freedoom](https://freedoom.github.io/) Phase 1 (all 36 maps).

## How it was made

This project was built with AI. The code was written by Claude (Opus 5.5) via a harness.

## Installing

1. Download `FreedoomArcade-v0.3.0.zip` from the [latest release](https://github.com/petllama/FreedoomArcade/releases/latest).
2. Unzip it and copy the five folders (`FreedoomArcade`, `FreedoomArcade_E1` .. `FreedoomArcade_E4`) into `World of Warcraft/<flavor>/Interface/AddOns/`.
3. Enable Freedoom Arcade in the AddOns list, log in, and click the Doom face on your minimap (or type `/arcade`).

Everything the game needs is in the zip. The release also has `freedoom1.wad`, the original Freedoom data it was built from, if you want to rebuild the assets yourself.

## Building

Requirements: Python 3, `ffmpeg` (for sound conversion), and a copy of the linuxdoom source (for the state/thing tables).

```sh
# 1. get Freedoom and id's source
curl -LO https://github.com/freedoom/freedoom/releases/download/v0.13.0/freedoom-0.13.0.zip
unzip freedoom-0.13.0.zip -d wad
git clone https://github.com/id-Software/DOOM.git ref/DOOM

# 2. convert the WAD into textures (TGA), sounds (OGG), maps and info tables
python tools/build_assets.py wad/freedoom-0.13.0/freedoom1.wad build/FreedoomArcade ref/DOOM/linuxdoom-1.10

# 3. copy the Lua sources in
sh tools/deploy.sh
```

Then copy `build/FreedoomArcade` and `build/FreedoomArcade_E1` .. `FreedoomArcade_E4` into `World of Warcraft/<flavor>/Interface/AddOns/`.

The `FreedoomArcade_E*` addons hold the map data and load on demand when you enter an episode.

## Playing

Type `/arcade` (or `/freedoom`, `/arcade`) in game.

The table shows the QWERTY keys, the default. On an AZERTY keyboard,
`/arcade keys azerty` plays on ZQSD; `/arcade keys wow` plays with the keys your
character moves with in WoW and your action button 1 – 7 keys, on any keyboard.

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Move | W / S |
| Strafe | A / D |
| Turn | arrows or Q / E, or hold right mouse and drag |
| Fire | Ctrl or left click |
| Use | Space or F |
| Weapons | 1 – 7 |
| Walk (always-run is on) | Shift |
| Pause | P |
| Automap | Tab or M (zoom with + / - or mouse wheel) |
| Quick save / load | F6 / F9 |
| Menu | Esc |

Slash commands:

- `/arcade size <400-1600>` sets the window width.
- `/arcade detail high|low` switches between 320 and 160 render columns.
- `/arcade sens <n>` sets mouse turn speed.
- `/arcade run` toggles always-run.
- `/arcade sound` toggles sound effects.
- `/arcade fps` shows an FPS counter.
- `/arcade warp e1m5 [skill]` jumps to a map.
- `/arcade save` / `/arcade load` quick save and load.
- `/arcade save <1-5>` / `/arcade load <1-5>` use five named save slots.
- Minimap button: left-click opens or closes the game. Right-click opens a menu with quick save/load and the five save slots, each showing its map and time. Drag the button to move it.
- `/arcade minimap` shows or hides the minimap button.
- `/arcade keys qwerty|azerty|wow` picks the keys: `qwerty` (the default) plays on WASD with Q / E to turn, `azerty` on ZQSD with A / E to turn, `wow` with the keys your character moves with and the keys of action buttons 1 – 7 (an action WoW leaves unbound, or binds only with a modifier, keeps its QWERTY key: 3 for action button 3). `/arcade keys` says which is on.
- `/arcade aggro` toggles pause-on-aggro (on by default). When your character enters combat, the game quick-saves, pauses and closes so the keyboard goes back to WoW. `/arcade` brings it back, and P resumes.

## Releasing

Releases are automated by `.github/workflows/release.yml`.

1. Bump `## Version` in `src/FreedoomArcade.toc`.
2. Add a matching `## x.y.z` section to `CHANGELOG.md`.
3. Push a tag `vx.y.z`.

The workflow then:

1. Downloads Freedoom and id's source.
2. Builds the assets.
3. Runs the tests.
4. Creates the GitHub release.
5. Uploads the zip to CurseForge.

One-time CurseForge setup:

1. Create the project on CurseForge.
2. Add the repository **variable** `CF_PROJECT_ID`, the numeric id from the project page.
3. Add the repository **secret** `CF_API_TOKEN`, from https://authors.curseforge.com/#/settings/api-tokens.
4. Optionally add the variable `CF_GAME_VERSIONS`, e.g. `12.1.0,1.15.7`, to override the versions read from the toc.

Without the token, the CurseForge upload step is skipped.

`curseforge/` holds the project description and the art:

- `logo_square.png` / `avatar.png` (400x400 project avatar)
- `logo.png` (1200x400 banner)

Both images are made by `tools/make_logo.py` from Freedoom's logo, big font and face.

## Testing offline

`tools/mock_wow.lua` is a small mock of the WoW UI API plus a software rasterizer for the textures it creates. It lets the real addon code run and take screenshots under LuaJIT:

```sh
export WOWDOOM_ADDONS="$(pwd)/build"
luajit tools/test_specials.lua   # every map, doors, lifts, exits, death/respawn
luajit tools/test_game.lua       # scripted play with screenshots in shots/
luajit tools/bench.lua 1 high    # per-frame cost
```

## Not implemented

- Music
- Distance-based sound volume. Distant sounds are culled instead, because WoW can't set per-sound volume.

## License

Freedoom Arcade was formerly called WoWDoom. The game code is derived from id Software's Doom source and is licensed under the GNU GPL v2 (see `LICENSE`). Freedoom assets are BSD-licensed. The Freedoom WAD and the converted assets (textures, sounds, maps) are not committed to the source tree. They are built from the WAD by the release workflow and ship in the addon zip on the [releases page](https://github.com/petllama/FreedoomArcade/releases). Each release also has `freedoom1.wad` and its license attached.

releases.name: Freedoom Arcade v0.3.0
releases.notes:
- Renamed from WoWDoom to **Freedoom Arcade**.
  - The addon folders are now `FreedoomArcade` and `FreedoomArcade_E1`–`E4`.
  - `/arcade` and `/freedoom` open the game; `/doom` still works.
- The release zip now contains only the addon folders, ready for the CurseForge app.
- The GPL license is included in the addon folder.
- Releases are built, tested and published automatically from GitHub.

releases.name: WoWDoom v0.2.2 - Save slots on the minimap button
releases.notes:
## New: save menu on the minimap button
**Right-click** the Doom face on the minimap for:
- **Open / Close game**
- **Quick save** (same as F6)
- **Quick load** (same as F9). Shows which map the quick save is on and when it was made.
- **Save to slot 1–5**: five named slots, each showing the map and time of what's in it. Saving over a used slot is marked *(overwrite)*.
- **Load slot 1–5**: loading opens the game window.

Options that can't be used right now are grayed out. For example, you can't save when no game is running, and empty slots can't be loaded. The menu closes when you pick something, click elsewhere, or press Escape.

Slash commands `/doom save 1`–`5` and `/doom load 1`–`5` do the same. Saves persist across reloads and logouts.

## Install / update
Download **WoWDoom-v0.2.2.zip** and copy the five folders into `World of Warcraft/<flavor>/Interface/AddOns/`, replacing the old ones. Only the `WoWDoom` folder changed.

releases.name: WoWDoom v0.2.1 - Minimap button
releases.notes:
## New: minimap button
A Doom face now sits on the edge of your minimap.
- **Left-click:** opens or closes the game.
- **Right-click:** opens the game and quick-loads your save.
- **Drag:** moves it around the minimap. Its position is remembered.
- `/doom minimap` hides or shows it.

On clients with the addon compartment (the retail addons dropdown), WoWDoom also appears there with the same icon.

## Install / update
Download **WoWDoom-v0.2.1.zip** and copy the five folders into `World of Warcraft/<flavor>/Interface/AddOns/`, replacing the old ones. Only the `WoWDoom` folder changed.

releases.name: WoWDoom v0.2.0 - Quick save & pause on aggro
releases.notes:
## New: quick save / load
- **F6** quick-saves and **F9** quick-loads. `/doom save` and `/doom load` do the same.
- A save captures the whole level: doors and lifts mid-move, every monster's position and AI state, your health, ammo and weapons, the automap, and the random seed. Loading a save plays out exactly the same as before you saved.
- Saves are kept in the addon's SavedVariables, so they survive `/reload` and logging out. There is one quick-save slot.

## New: pause on aggro
When your WoW character enters combat while Doom is open:
1. The game quick-saves and pauses.
2. The window closes, so your keyboard goes straight back to your character.
3. A raid-warning style alert tells you why.

When the fight is over, type `/doom` to return. The game stays paused until you press **P**. Turn this off with `/doom aggro`.

## Install / update
Download **WoWDoom-v0.2.0.zip** and copy the five folders into `World of Warcraft/<flavor>/Interface/AddOns/`, replacing the old ones. Only the `WoWDoom` folder changed.

## Still not implemented
- Music

releases.name: WoWDoom v0.1.1 - Automap
releases.notes:
## New: automap
Press **Tab** (or **M**) to switch between the 3D view and a top-down map of the level, like Doom's.

- **Red:** walls
- **Brown:** floor steps and ledges
- **Yellow:** ceiling height changes
- **Blue / yellow / red:** locked doors, in the color of their key
- **Gray:** areas revealed by the Computer Area Map pickup that you haven't visited yet
- **White arrow:** you

Zoom with **+ / -** or the **mouse wheel**. The game keeps running while the map is open.

## Install / update
Download **WoWDoom-v0.1.1.zip** and copy the five folders into `World of Warcraft/<flavor>/Interface/AddOns/`, replacing the old ones. Only the `WoWDoom` folder changed since v0.1.0.

`freedoom1.wad` and `FREEDOOM-COPYING.txt` are the same as in v0.1.0 and attached for completeness.

## Still not implemented
- Music
- Save/load
